Data, rules and limitations

BlueSky TERRA parcels and generic water-stress replay, plus the Apetit challenge’s synthetic survey and calculator tables. © Since AI ry 2026, CC BY 4.0. Globe matching uses parcel centres and sums whole matched parcel areas.

Mission flags overlap. Climate uses at least 40% modelled stress days in 2050 SSP5-8.5 and a rise of at least 10 percentage points from 2026. Margin uses a negative entered crop margin or yield below 80% of the regional crop median. Nitrogen uses at least 125% of the median. Environment uses carbon intensity at least 125% of median or a management proxy below 0.35. Up Your Game uses a provisional shortlist. Yield must reach 90% of the regional median, nitrogen and carbon must be within 115% of their medians, and the other screens must pass. If entered, margin must reach €75/ha. Benchmarks need five farms. These are demonstration thresholds. Carbon excludes land-use change and organic-soil emissions. The nature score describes practices, and the stress replay is synthetic.
